MP3 2 Ringtone is a Sound convertor application. It uses MP3 songs in your iPod Library to make ringtones. 

This application has good features beside converting,

* App is working on all iPhone models
* App supports fade effects for the beginning and end of the song.
* With fine tuning feature, you never miss a tone note.
* App supports file manager to manage app's shared folder.

NOTE: MP3 purchased from iTunes Store put DRM on all songs.So they contain copyright protection and cannot be used as input to create ringtones.
